title: Implicit Smooth Ambiguity: Perception, Attitude, and Identification
abstract: arXiv:2609.26964v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a model of identifiable smooth ambiguity in a finite-state Anscombe-Aumann framework in which ambiguity perception and the ambiguity-attitude representation may depend on the act's endogenous certainty-equivalent utility level. The framework separates two sources of utility-level dependence that standard smooth-ambiguity models hold fixed. Neutral-transfer experiments within revealed cells recover conditional beliefs, while compensation experiments across cells recover cell weights and locally revealed ambiguity-attitude scales. These objects have distinct behavioral content. After the within-level structure is extended globally, ambiguity perception is identified at each certainty-equivalent level, whereas variation in admissible level-specific global attitude indices need not by itself reflect behaviorally identified variation in ambiguity attitude. translated_title: 隐性平滑模糊性：感知、态度与识别
translated_abstract: 本文在有限状态 Anscombe-Aumann 框架下发展了一个可识别的平滑模糊性模型，其中模糊性感知与模糊性态度的表达可以依赖于行为的内生确定性等价效用水平。该框架区分了标准平滑模糊性模型中固定不变的两个效用水平依赖来源。在已显示的单元格内部进行的中性转移实验可以恢复条件信念，而跨单元格的补偿实验可以恢复单元格权重以及局部显示的模糊性态度量表。这些对象具有不同的行为内容。在将单元格内部结构全局扩展后，模糊性感知可以在每个确定性等价水平上被识别，而可容许的特定水平全局态度指标的变化本身未必反映行为上可识别的模糊性态度变化。跨水平限制决定了局部显示的态度在何种条件下可以…（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文构建了一个模糊性感知与态度可随确定性等价效用水平变化的可识别平滑模糊性模型，并通过单元格内中性转移实验与跨单元格补偿实验分别识别条件信念、单元格权重与模糊性态度量表。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an identifiable smooth ambiguity model in which ambiguity perception and attitude may depend on endogenous certainty-equivalent utility levels, identifying conditional beliefs via within-cell neutral-transfer experiments and cell weights and ambiguity-attitude scales via cross-cell compensation experiments.
